goal: Path traversal review: file paths built from input and checked after normalisation.
use: Path traversal review: file paths built from input and checked after normalisation. Use when code opens, reads, writes or deletes files using a path from outside.

steps.note: Find the paths. List each file operation and where its path comes from.
Check joins. Flag paths built by string concatenation with user input.
Check normalisation. The resolved path must stay inside the allowed folder.
Check symbolic links. Flag operations that follow links out of the folder.
Report. Each operation with file and line, severity and the fix.
